name: Campingplatz Farmcamping Branger Alm
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Farmcamping Branger Alm is located in the peaceful village of Unterperfuss in the Tyrolean Inntal valley, offering an authentic farm-stay camping experience. The setting is characterised by open meadows and the majestic backdrop of the Nordkette mountains. Facilities include well-maintained sanitary blocks and electricity hookups. Guests can purchase fresh, wholesome farm produce directly on site, with the cultural highlights of regional capital Innsbruck only a short drive away.
